messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — we're planning to deprecate the implicit default (no Accept-Model) routing to 'latest' next Wed. Need a short compat checklist + comms plan.

lina: Wait, what's the new default? Are we forcing clients to send an Accept-Model header?

sam: New default will be explicit 'stable-1' for 90 days. After that we'll start returning 3xx deprecation warnings and then 410 after 30 days if no pin. We want clients to opt-in with Accept-Model or pin via SDK.

mika: For Dedicated customers, can we keep previous behavior behind a feature flag? Some customers rely on implicit moves.

sam: yes — Dedicated & Private will get a toggle for 'legacy-unpinned-routing' until end of quarter. We should log usage and contact any heavy users.

roland: From an SRE perspective, we need clear fallback behavior in the runtime. Proposal:
```text
1) If Accept-Model header present -> route to pinned model
2) Else if client SDK pin present -> route
3) Else -> route to 'stable-1' and add response header `X-Model-Routed: stable-1` + `X-Deprecation-Notice: true`
``` 
Can we also emit a metric `request.unpinned.routed`?

sam: Yep. Add metric and an event in rollout dashboard. Also add a circuit-breaker to fall back to 'compat-1' if stable-1 latency spikes.

amy: Docs+SDK action: add middleware that auto-sets Accept-Model based on user's configured default. We'll need a clear deprecation blurb and email template. I'll draft.

lina: Quick Q: will response shape change between stable-1 and compat-1? We can't break clients that rely on `data.output_text` vs `choices[0].text`.

sam: No intentional shape changes. But add a runtime shim that ensures both `data.output_text` and `choices` are populated for a period. Put shape checks in the preflight tests.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-3241 pinning-deprecation-checklist (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3241)

mika: I'll ping enterprise CS for a list of customers using unpinned route >50%.

roland: Can someone OWN the rollback plan? If stable-1 regresses we need a quick revert. Suggest @lina on-call to open a rollback PR and @sam to trigger capacity shift.

lina: I can own rollback PR and verification steps.

sam: Thanks. Action items:
- @amy draft comms + docs blurb (by EOD)
- @mika customer outreach list (tomorrow)
- @lina rollback PR & preflight tests (in morning)
- @roland add metrics + circuit-breaker config (by EOD)
- @devops create toggle for Dedicated/Private (blocked on deploy ticket)

amy: ack :thumbsup:

lina: quick nit: header name we picked `Accept-Model` or `Model-Accept`? let's standardize.

sam: Use `Accept-Model` (matches Accept-* semantics). Add to SDKs and server negotiation docs.

mika: Any objection to adding a warning header `X-Deprecation-Notice: pin required by YYYY-MM-DD` for a grace period?

sam: Good idea. Add that for 60 days after change.

roland: I'll schedule a 15m follow-up tomorrow. If no objections I will merge rollout tomorrow morning.

sam: no objections recorded. thanks everyone, will post final rollout notes when tickets are linked.
